prompt:
I filmed this object being moved. Write a URDF of it that I can load into MuJoCo to simulate it.

- Links: simple box or cylinder geometry, sized in metres to match the real object.
- Joints: the right type, axis, origin and limits, so the model moves the way the object moves in the video.

Make it as close to the real object as you can tell from the video. Reply with the complete URDF in one ```xml code block.
answer:
```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<robot name="old_laptop">
  <!-- World / table reference -->
  <link name="world">
    <inertial>
      <mass value="0.0001"/>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <inertia ixx="1e-6" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="1e-6" iyz="0" izz="1e-6"/>
    </inertial>
  </link>

  <!-- Laptop base - stays on table -->
  <link name="base_link">
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.22 0.28 0.035"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="beige">
        <color rgba="0.82 0.81 0.76 1.0"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
    <!-- keyboard inset for appearance -->
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0.01 0 0.0175" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.16 0.24 0.004"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="keyboard">
        <color rgba="0.75 0.74 0.70 1.0"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.22 0.28 0.035"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="1.8"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.01194" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="0.00744" iyz="0" izz="0.01902"/>
    </inertial>
  </link>

  <!-- Laptop lid / screen - rotates about rear hinge -->
  <link name="lid_link">
    <!-- lid box, centre offset forward from hinge -->
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0.11 0 0.0125" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.22 0.28 0.025"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="beige_lid">
        <color rgba="0.82 0.81 0.76 1.0"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
    <!-- black screen on inner face (faces keyboard when closed) -->
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0.11 0 0.0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.19 0.24 0.002"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="screen">
        <color rgba="0.02 0.02 0.03 1.0"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0.11 0 0.0125" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.22 0.28 0.025"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0.11 0 0.0125" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="0.6"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.00395" ixy="0" ixz="0" iyy="0.00245" iyz="0" izz="0.00634"/>
    </inertial>
  </link>

  <!-- Fix base to table -->
  <joint name="world_to_base" type="fixed">
    <parent link="world"/>
    <child link="base_link"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0.0175" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- Rear hinge: closed = 0, open ~100 deg = -1.85 rad -->
  <joint name="lid_hinge" type="revolute">
    <parent link="base_link"/>
    <child link="lid_link"/>
    <origin xyz="-0.11 0 0.0175" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="0 1 0"/>
    <limit lower="-1.85" upper="0.0" effort="10.0" velocity="2.0"/>
    <dynamics damping="0.2" friction="0.1"/>
  </joint>
</robot>
```
